title: Invoice rules
say: When a job ships and its checks pass, Draft when ready makes the invoice.

title: Job board stages
say: Each column on the board is a work stage, from Received through to Shipped.

title: Faster Xero matching
say: Flow can link an approved Xero invoice before anyone has paid it.

title: Drafts go to Ready
say: The draft the automation made is already sitting on Ready.

title: Own price list
say: Flow keeps its own price, and shows when the Xero price is different.

title: Fresh data before send
say: The job changed after the draft. Accept the change before you send.

title: Custom fields on jobs
say: This stage change has to happen in Seazona. Flow waits for it.

title: Group, sort and filter
say: Group, sort and filter stay with this account after a reload.

title: Xero badges
say: A sent invoice wears a Paid in Xero badge once Xero has the payment.

title: Email invitations
say: Invite emails the person, and they show on the list as Invited.

title: Reconcile finds the gaps
say: Reconcile finds the invoice that matches this job. Link them.

title: Six invoice tabs
say: Invoices move through Pending, Ready, Draft, Approved, Sent and Void.

title: Xero payments come back to Flow
say: A payment recorded in Xero comes back onto the Flow invoice.

title: Reconcile list
say: Reconcile puts jobs and invoices in the one list.

title: Pending notes
say: Pending holds the invoice until the case reference is on the job.

title: Rules on cards
say: Rules open as cards. Each card has its own page.

title: Filters and saved views
say: Add a nested filter, and And joins the two conditions.

title: Ask for a reply
say: Tick Request a response when the report needs a written reply.

title: Invoice columns
say: Show Shipped, Case and Practitioner as columns on the invoice list.

title: Send to Xero keeps going
say: Send to Xero keeps going. This job could not be confirmed, so it stayed Ready.

title: Create a missing Xero client
say: This client is not in Xero yet. Create them from here.

title: Seazona fix
say: Seazona is connected, and the old missed-invoice alert is gone.

title: Xero contacts both ways
say: Turn on Two-way edits, and a contact change goes either way.

title: Non-chargeable tab
say: Non-chargeable work stays in the lab, and Flow never bills it.
